name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 7 · repasser, sécher, tremper
note: Tiered verb place; all six verbs are -er, so all live on the LEFT cottages (the right side is a flowery stone wall with no verbs). Street: woman rubbing her hands over frothy hot chocolate, grandma ironing, socks drying with a lavender sachet; balcony: trumpeter dunking a biscuit in milk; upper window: bushy-haired heir pouring from his inherited teapot; roof terrace: dog snapping its chain. Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
